description: LARP check: is there a real product behind a coin on Robinhood Chain or Solana? Toll reads the coin's own site, launch post and code README, lists each thing it says it offers, and checks every claim against the chain and against its working parts that Toll tries itself (app page, API, MCP server, x402 payments, Chrome extension, Telegram bot, public code). Answers the label (tech found / partly found / not found / not read: what we could check, never a verdict), each claim with found / partly / not found and the line that shows it, and the working parts that answered. A coin nobody asked about yet is queued and read within minutes: the answer says how many seconds to wait before calling again. Free: 10 new coins a day per caller, coins already read are always free.

chain.description: Which chain: rh = Robinhood Chain, sol = Solana. Leave it out and Toll tells them apart by the address (0x is Robinhood Chain, base58 is Solana).

token.description: The coin: its token contract on Robinhood Chain, or its Solana mint: 0x followed by 40 hex characters, or a Solana mint address (base58, case-sensitive)
